theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+1.29%) and Consumer Discretionary (+0.64%) led the market today, while Energy (-1.93%) and Real Estate (-0.90%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.54% versus -0.17% for defensives and -0.48% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.13% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +0.02%. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.96%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 3.48% to 17.75, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.11% to $4,074.50, crude oil was little changed at $100.01, and bitcoin gained 0.60% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
